remembered_findings.problem: The sweep's bulk update keys only on the previously selected session IDs, so a session that became active again in between is still ended and its viewers see a false session end.
The sweep marks all selected rows ended before emitting, so any emit failure is never retried and viewers can be left without a terminal event.
An author reply noting both P1 findings were fixed with a conditional single-row staleness update, per-row emit on the sweep, and a regression test.
A sweep that grabs the session row lock before a queued event append marks a still-active session ended and broadcasts session.end while events keep flowing.
When persisting the synthetic terminal event fails after the row is already marked ended, only a log is written and later sweeps skip the row, so the terminal event never reaches viewers.
The README quick start omits the prerequisite login and required --project argument, so the documented attach command fails for a new user.
The architecture doc says blocking happens via command hooks and exit code 2, but the real transport is HTTP hooks with a JSON deny, so the documented approach fails open.
The self-managed deployment guide never says the proxy must split API and health traffic to the relay and the rest to the web service, leaving one service unreachable.
A CI job failed with exit code 1, indicating a broken build or failing check.
